annotations.title: Plan a trip within a budget

description: Plans a whole trip, home to home, within the total budget the traveller gives: flights, stays, transfers, activities, visas and daily costs. Use it when someone asks to plan or price a trip and has said where from, when, how many travellers and the total budget; the destination can be named or left to Trip720 with 'surprise'. Returns up to six options, each with its Safe Trip Total (the whole trip with a contingency for what can change), the route with nights in each place, every priced line labelled live (checked with the provider), estimate (Trip720's own, protection margin included) or official (a government fee), and a link to the option on trip720.travel. Limits: at most 6 travellers, 60 nights and 5 named places; flight fares in this quick build are often estimates; a daily limit is shared by all users of AI apps. A trip still being built comes back with status 'building': read it again with get_trip after about a minute. Side effects: each call saves a new trip on Trip720 for 30 days, under a new trip id, so it can be read again, changed or opened on trip720.travel. Nothing is booked or paid.

amount.description: Total for everyone, home to home, in the currency's main unit (9000 = 9,000 dollars).

towns.description: Towns to include; empty lets Trip720 choose within the country.

destination.description: 'surprise' to let Trip720 choose, or up to 5 places.

interests.description: Finer interests in words, e.g. 'street art', 'hiking'.

origin.description: Where the trip starts and ends, as the traveller said it in the request. Trip data, not the user's location: never fill it from device or account location.

country.description: Two-letter country code of that town, e.g. 'AU'.

place.description: The town or airport the trip starts from, e.g. 'Adelaide' or 'ADL'.

pace.description: PACKED: see as much as possible; RELAXED: take it slowly; SETTLED: one place.

returnDate.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 60 nights later.

travellers.description: At most 6 travellers in all. No names.

passport.description: Two-letter passport country, for visa rules. The home country when not given.
